title: Shabby Wardrobe

sources.title: Shabby Wardrobe
markers: '''Shabby Wardrobe''' is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. Usually contains random poor [[Camp Clothing]] and [[Miscellaneous]] items such as [[Rags]].

summary: Static wardrobe containing random poor camp clothing and clutter.

fields.Use: Open to inspect or retrieve contents. It cannot be picked up or moved.
fields.Base value: No nominal price listed by the source.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
